free_design.Place: A private compact sleeper cabin on a civilian orbital ferry, warm window light, padded bunk and a small vacuum-storage bag for blankets.
free_design.Activity: She gently presses air from a storage bag to pack a bulky quilt efficiently; leaning forward pulls one overlapping side panel of her short sleepwear outward, revealing more of her upper thigh without moving any intimate coverage.
free_design.Pose: Sitting on the edge of the bunk with both feet on the floor, torso leaning forward naturally, right palm presses the bag and left hand holds its plain valve cap; looking down with a small amused smile, both hands fully connected and visible.
free_design.Framing: Three-quarter frontal view from the knees upward, camera at seated chest height, cabin activity clearly visible.
free_design.Outfit: A midnight-violet lingerie-inspired two-piece of opaque satin: a supportive ruched bandeau top with broad crossed shoulder bands and a little gathered peplum, plus fitted sleep shorts covered by two curved overlapping tulip panels; a soft simple shoulder shawl folded beside her, not worn. No mecha armor, no faction palette.
